first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: green soccer field
entities.identification: A green grass playing field covering the middle and lower portions of the image, with white penalty-area, goal-area, and penalty-arc markings.

entities.name: sideline advertising barrier
entities.identification: Long rectangular advertising boards arranged along the far side and right end of the field, predominantly with white board surfaces.

entities.name: group of players in green clothing
entities.identification: The set of players on the field wearing green shirts, green shorts, and white knee-high socks.

entities.name: group of players in dark clothing
entities.identification: The set of players on the field wearing blue-and-black vertically striped shirts, dark shorts, and knee-high socks, excluding Person C and Person E.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The goalkeeper wearing a red kit and positioned on the side of Object E facing the field.

entities.name: Person E
entities.identification: The referee on the field wearing a bright yellow shirt, black shorts, and dark knee-high socks.

entities.name: soccer ball
entities.identification: A small white nearly spherical ball that changes position with the action within the playing area.

entities.name: Object E
entities.identification: The white goal defended by Person C, with white goalposts, a crossbar, and part of a light-colored goal net visible.

entities.name: gray tiered stands
entities.identification: Gray stepped stands extending along the far side and right end of the field in the upper portion of the image.

entities.name: group of spectators in the stands
entities.identification: A large number of spectators gathered in the seating area of the stands, appearing as dense outlines of heads and upper bodies.

entities.name: off-field group of people in vests
entities.identification: The set of people on the off-field passageway wearing bright yellow or orange vests, excluding Person E on the field.

entities.name: off-field gray rigid passageway
entities.identification: A long, narrow gray hard-surfaced ground area between the lower edge of the stands and the sideline advertising barrier.
